title: HustleBox v1.3.0 — Dynamics
message:
The block starts to feel alive.

CUSTOMER PERSONALITIES
Every customer now has a personality. 8 types: Talkative, In a hurry, Foodie, Regular, Tourist, Drunk, Skeptic, Quiet. Each one affects:
• Patience — talkers and tourists wait longer, rushers cut you 25%
• Tips — tourists and talkers tip well, skeptics never tip, drunks tip randomly
• Reputation — skeptics dock you extra rep if the order isn't perfect
• Chatter — talkers actually say multiple things while you assemble ("Long day at the truck, huh?", "You new?", "Smells good in here")

The personality label shows under each customer's face during the shift, so you know who you're dealing with.

MENU TRENDS
The game now tracks every item you serve. Lifetime counts plus a rolling window of the last 100 orders. Items get classified as trending up (>18% share), trending down (<8% share), or your overall bestseller. Eventually this drives in-game events; for now you can see your top seller right on the Home screen.

NEW MENU ITEMS
Three additions:
• 🌯 Burrito — $7, bigger portion than tacos
• ☕ Coffee — $3, fast item, pairs with donuts for combos
• 🥪 Sandwich — $6, mid-tier lunch staple

The menu is now 11 items strong.

SIDE HUSTLE
New Home screen widget. Between shifts, Marcus can take on small errands that run passively in the background. Walk a dog, run groceries, deliver a package, wash a car, help someone move. 8–25 minutes real time, 30–240 Stacks payout. Only one runs at a time. Tap Claim when the bar fills.

RAY'S BACK ROOM LOCKOUT
Get too greedy down there and Ray catches you. If you lose 500+ Stacks net in the back room, or drop below 50 Stacks with significant losses, Ray locks the door. 4-hour real-time cooldown. Tapping the Back Room tab during a lockout shows a red "BACK ROOM LOCKED" screen with a countdown and one of Ray's threats.

THROUGH THE WALL — Eavesdrop scene
New More menu entry that appears after you've served 30+ customers. You stand outside Ray's office. A thin strip of light glows under the door. You hear voices: Ray, Sal (the hardware store owner), and Marcus himself listening. They discuss your menu performance in real time — "Look at the numbers. Burger. That's our thing now." "The salad isn't moving. We should cut it." The conversation content is generated from your live trend data, so it actually means something. TTS plays each line if you have Customer Voices on; subtitles render either way. No characters drawn — just a wall, a door, a glowing crack, and a pulsing audio indicator. The mystery is the point.

TOP SELLER BADGE
Home screen now shows a small badge with your current bestseller and how many items are trending up or down. Appears once you have 20+ recent orders.

No save data wiped. Existing saves auto-migrate to add the new fields.
